title: Learn how cars work, in interactive 3D
text: Free interactive lessons on how cars work: engines, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and more, with live 3D labs, quizzes and the engineers behind each part.

title: How Cars Work: Every Lesson by System
text: Browse 34 free lessons on how cars work, from engines, fuel and cooling to gearboxes, brakes, suspension, tyres and electrics.

title: Basics & Fundamentals
text: How the major systems of a car fit together, and the physics vocabulary used everywhere else. 2 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Engine
text: Four-stroke operation, pistons, crankshafts, valves, camshafts and engine layouts. 4 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Fuel & Ignition
text: Fuel delivery, injection, petrol and diesel combustion, spark and compression ignition. 3 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Cooling & Lubrication
text: How engines shed heat and keep metal surfaces separated by oil films. 2 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Transmission & Clutch
text: Clutches, manual and automatic gearboxes, gear ratios and torque multiplication. 4 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Drivetrain & Differentials
text: Driveshafts, differentials and the layouts that carry power to the wheels. 3 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Brakes
text: Hydraulic brakes, discs, drums, pads and anti-lock braking. 3 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Suspension & Steering
text: Springs, dampers, linkages and steering geometry that keep tyres in contact with the road. 3 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Wheels & Tyres
text: Tyre construction, grip, slip and the contact patch. 1 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Electrical Systems
text: Battery, starter motor, alternator, charging and vehicle electrics. 2 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Heating & Air Conditioning
text: Cabin heating, ventilation and the refrigeration cycle. 1 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Bodywork & Chassis
text: Monocoque and ladder frames, crash structures and materials. 1 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Aerodynamics & Technology
text: Drag, downforce and modern automotive technology. 2 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Maintenance & Troubleshooting
text: Servicing, diagnosing common faults and sensible modifications. 2 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Driving Technique
text: How mechanical understanding translates into smoother, safer driving. 1 free lessons, surface to engineering detail.

title: Air Conditioning
text: How car air conditioning moves heat out of the cabin: refrigerant, compressor, condenser, expansion valve and evaporator, and why AC also dries the air.

title: Alternator and Charging
text: How a belt-driven alternator powers the car and recharges the battery: rotating magnet, stator, rectifier diodes, voltage regulator and warning signs.

title: Anti-lock Braking (ABS)
text: Why a locked wheel slides and cannot steer, how ABS senses wheel speed and pulses brake pressure many times a second, and what the pedal judder means.

title: Automatic Transmission
text: How a conventional automatic changes gear by itself: torque converter, planetary gearsets, clutches and bands, compared with CVT and dual-clutch boxes.

title: Battery and Starter Motor
text: How a 12-volt battery and starter motor crank the engine: solenoid, pinion and flywheel ring gear, cold cranking amps, and why cars won't start.

title: Brake Hydraulics
text: How a light push on the brake pedal becomes tonnes of clamping force: pedal leverage, brake servo, master cylinder, brake fluid and caliper pistons.

title: Car Aerodynamics
text: How air resistance shapes cars: the drag equation, why drag power rises with the cube of speed, drag coefficient, frontal area, lift and downforce.

title: Chassis Construction
text: How a car's structure carries loads and protects occupants: ladder frames, monocoques and space frames, torsional stiffness and crumple zones.

title: Diagnosing Warning Signs
text: How to read your car's warning signs: dashboard lights, noises, smells, smoke and changes in feel, which need immediate action, and what OBD codes are.

title: Diesel Engines
text: How a diesel engine ignites fuel without spark plugs, why high compression makes it efficient and torquey, and how common-rail injection works.

title: Disc Brakes
text: How disc brakes stop a car: pads squeezed onto a spinning disc turn kinetic energy into heat. See a stop in 3D, learn brake fade and why discs are vented.

title: Driveshafts and CV Joints
text: How propshafts, universal joints and constant-velocity joints carry drive to wheels that steer and bounce, and what a clicking CV joint is telling you.

title: Drivetrain Layouts
text: Front-, rear- and all-wheel drive compared: which wheels push the car, where the engine and gearbox sit, and how layout affects traction and handling.

title: Engine Cooling System
text: How coolant carries heat from the engine to the radiator: water pump, thermostat, radiator, fan and pressure cap, and what overheating warnings mean.

title: Engine Layouts: Inline, V and Flat
text: Why engines come as inline-fours, straight-sixes, V8s and flat boxers: how cylinder layout affects size, balance, smoothness and where the engine fits.

title: Fuel Injection
text: How an engine computer meters fuel: air-flow and oxygen sensors, injectors and pulse width, port vs direct injection, and why carburettors disappeared.

title: Gear Ratios and Torque Multiplication
text: How to work out a gear ratio from tooth counts, why low gears multiply torque and high gears save fuel, and how overall gearing sets speed at each rpm.

title: How a Car Works: The Big Picture
text: How a car turns fuel or battery energy into motion: engine, transmission, driveline, brakes, steering and suspension, and how they work together.

title: Hybrid and Electric Drives
text: How electric and hybrid cars drive: battery, inverter and motor, instant torque, regenerative braking, and how series, parallel and plug-in hybrids differ.

title: Lubrication System
text: How engine oil keeps metal parts apart: oil pump, filter and galleries, the pressurised oil film in bearings, viscosity grades, and the oil warning light.

title: Mechanical Sympathy
text: How driving with the car's engineering in mind saves fuel and wear: gentle warm-ups, sensible revs, smooth inputs, anticipation and engine braking.

title: Pistons, Connecting Rods and the Crankshaft
text: How a crankshaft turns the pistons' up-and-down push into rotation: rings, wrist pin, connecting rod, crank throw, counterweights and flywheel explained.

title: Routine Maintenance
text: Simple checks every owner can make, from tyres, oil, coolant and lights to brakes and wipers, which parts are replaced on schedule, and why it pays off.

title: Spark Ignition and Combustion Timing
text: How a spark plug lights the compressed mixture, why the spark fires before top dead centre, how the flame spreads, and what engine knock is.

title: Springs and Dampers
text: How springs carry the car and dampers (shock absorbers) control its bounce: spring rate, damping, ride frequency, and what worn shocks feel like.

title: Steering Systems
text: How turning the steering wheel turns the front wheels: rack-and-pinion gearing, tie rods, Ackermann geometry, and how power steering assists you.

title: Suspension Basics
text: How a car's suspension keeps the tyres on the road and the body steady: springs, dampers, control arms, MacPherson struts and double wishbones.

title: The Clutch
text: How a friction clutch connects and disconnects engine and gearbox: friction disc, pressure plate, release bearing, the biting point, and clutch slip.

title: The Differential
text: Why wheels must turn at different speeds in a corner, how an open differential's gears allow it, and how limited-slip and locking diffs help traction.

title: The Four-Stroke Cycle
text: Intake, compression, power and exhaust: how a four-stroke petrol engine works over two crank turns, with an interactive 3D engine you can slow down.

title: The Manual Gearbox
text: How a five-speed manual transmission works: constant-mesh gears, layshaft, selector forks and synchronisers, and what happens when you change gear.

title: Torque and Power
text: Torque is twisting force; power is how fast that force does work. Learn P = Tω, why gears trade torque for speed, and how to read a torque curve.

title: Tyres and Grip
text: How tyres grip: the postcard-sized contact patch, friction and slip, why braking and cornering share grip, and what tread, pressure and heat change.

title: Valves, Camshafts and Valve Timing
text: How cam lobes open an engine's intake and exhaust valves at precise crank angles: lift, duration, valve overlap, and why the camshaft turns at half speed.

title: Interactive 3D Car Labs: Engine, Gearbox, Brakes
text: Run a four-stroke engine, a manual gearbox, disc brakes and a suspension corner in your browser: play, slow down, explode and select every part.

title: Four-Stroke Engine Laboratory
text: Watch intake, compression, power and exhaust with crank, piston, cam and valves on one synchronised timeline.

title: Manual Gearbox Laboratory
text: Select gears and see how ratio trades rotational speed for torque between input and output shafts.

title: Disc Brake Laboratory
text: Press the pedal, watch hydraulic pressure clamp the pads, and see kinetic energy become heat — with a conceptual ABS demo.

title: Suspension Laboratory
text: Drive over bumps and see the spring, damper and control arms keep the tyre on the road.

title: Explore a Car in 3D: Every System, Labelled
text: Explore a car in 3D: light up the engine, gearbox, brakes, suspension, steering and electrics, see where each part sits and open the lesson that explains it.

title: How Car Systems Connect: Engine to Wheels
text: See how the engine, clutch, gearbox, driveshafts, differential and wheels connect, and how front-, rear- and all-wheel-drive layouts change the power path.

title: Who Invented Car Parts? The Engineers Behind Them
text: 26 engineers behind the car's parts, from Ackermann steering to the radial tyre, Otto's engine to ABS: each story retold from a cited source.

title: Car Glossary: Automotive Terms Explained
text: Plain-language definitions of 147 automotive terms, from compression ratio and torque to slip angle and regenerative braking, each linked to its lesson.

title: About AutoVerse: Sources, Methods and Credits
text: What AutoVerse is, how its original lessons are written and checked, how third-party sources are handled, and credits for the 3D models it uses.
